category: client: WebDAV gateway over a debrid library

free_tier.stated: The server is a public release on GitHub and costs nothing; the debrid account behind it is the thing that costs. The stable release is Real-Debrid only: 'A self-hosted Real-Debrid webdav server written from scratch.' Nightlies add backends 'beyond Real-Debrid (TorBox, AllDebrid and Usenet)' and need an active sponsorship.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the gateway; the source account's cap applies.

retention.stated: not applicable: the WebDAV tree is a live view of the torrent library.

egress.terms: No meter of its own; it spends the debrid account's unmetered premium traffic.

interface_detail: Serves the torrent library over WebDAV on localhost:9999 by default, with a per-provider API under /api/providers/realdebrid/ (including /test). rclone mounts the WebDAV; Infuse can read it directly.
tooling: Ships a bundle with config.yml, docker-compose.yml, rclone.conf and Plex update scripts; 'rclone and ffprobe are automatically downloaded on first run if not already installed'. Docker image ghcr.io/debridmediamanager/zurg-testing.
chaining: The bridge that turned debrid into a filesystem for Plex: zurg exposes RD as WebDAV, rclone mounts it, Plex or Jellyfin scans it, and no download ever lands on local disk.

limits.value: paces itself to the upstream budget: api_rate_limit_per_minute 250 and torrents_rate_limit_per_minute 75 by default
paces torrent adds to a 20-second floor it discovered by measurement, because Real-Debrid refuses closer adds

limits_note: The gateway's own throttle exists because the upstream's limit is not the documented one: zurg had to add an add-pacing floor and a repair subsystem for links that stop working while the torrent still reports healthy.
binding_note: A pure client: at 1 TiB/month nothing in zurg fails first, the upstream add floor does. Listed as 'none' because that floor is Real-Debrid's and is recorded there.

identity_cost.detail: No account with the project; it needs a debrid API token, which it stores in config.yml.

reliability_note: The stable line is Real-Debrid only; every other backend is a sponsors-only nightly, so a user on the stable release cannot point it at TorBox or AllDebrid at all.
confidence_note: Repository README and the project's own provider notes were read. Nothing was run: the throughput and mount behaviour are untested here.

evidence.proved: 'A self-hosted Real-Debrid webdav server written from scratch', the rclone+Plex purpose, the requirements (RD account and API token), and that nightlies add 'TorBox, AllDebrid and Usenet' behind sponsorship
the 20-second add floor and the 250/75 per-minute pacing defaults, plus the repair subsystem's reason for existing

price_per_tb_month: USD 0 for the gateway; the debrid account is separate

extras.config_keys: api_rate_limit_per_minute, torrents_rate_limit_per_minute, api_timeout_secs, download_timeout_secs, retries_until_failed, retry_503_errors, fetch_torrents_page_size
